data.one_liner: Flutter widgets providing advanced text styling like gradients, strokes, neon, shadows, and rotation.
data.what_it_does: Textuality enhances the standard Flutter Text widget by providing various custom widgets for special text effects. It supports gradient text, strokes, neon glows, shadows, interactive gestures, multi-color spans, rotations, blurring, and bordered backgrounds.
use_when: You want to add stylized text effects like gradients, neon glows, or strokes without writing custom paint logic
You need interactive text elements or rotated text easily
avoid_when: You only need standard text styling provided by Flutter's built-in TextStyle and Text widget
You require complex localization or text layout engines
strengths: Provides a wide variety of pre-built text effect widgets out of the box
Simple API with optional parameters similar to standard text usage
weaknesses: Limited to specific pre-defined visual text effects

alternatives.name: auto_size_text
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick auto_size_text if you need text that automatically resizes to fit container bounds rather than visual styling effects.

data.minimal_example:
GradientText(
  text: 'Gradient Text',
  giveGradient: [Colors.blue, Colors.green],
  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 40, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
)
